items.title: Subagents vs Agent Skills: Executing Reusable Knowledge for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
items.title_zh: 子智能体与智能体技能：为长时程智能体任务执行可复用知识
items.summary: The paper compares executing reusable skill packages by loading their instructions into an agent's context against invoking them as subagents with fresh context windows. It reports that subagent execution works better when skills expose clear input-output contracts and encode procedural knowledge, at the cost of extra coordination tokens.

items.title: A*-Thought-V2: Efficient Latent Reasoning via Geometric Dynamics of LLM
items.title_zh: A*-Thought-V2：基于 LLM 几何动态的高效潜在推理
items.summary: A*-Thought-V2 treats chain-of-thought as a hidden-state trajectory in a 3D PCA space, keeping aligned steps as explicit text and compressing deviating steps into latent tokens. On Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.6-27B across six benchmarks it improves average accuracy by up to 2.6% while cutting response length by up to half.

items.title: APPSim-Bench: Bridging Real-world Apps and Reproducible Evaluation for Mobile GUI Agents
items.title_zh: APPSim-Bench：连接真实应用与可复现评估的移动 GUI 智能体基准
items.summary: The benchmark uses controllable simulated apps that preserve task-relevant interaction logic to evaluate mobile GUI agents reproducibly, covering 557 tasks across 17 Chinese and English apps. Across 19 agents, the best completes only 50.27% of tasks and 28.55% of tasks are solved by no agent.

items.title: TDDN: Text-aligned Diffused DINO Network for Puzzle Understanding
items.title_zh: TDDN：面向拼图理解的对齐扩散 DINO 网络
items.summary: TDDN fuses DINOv3 and CleanDIFT features into a perception encoder aligned with RoBERTa-L, using frozen backbones and about 590K alignment pairs. It surpasses CLIP ViT-L/14 on image-text retrieval and more than triples CLIP's dense-prediction accuracy on ADE20K and COCO-Stuff.

items.title: BanglaMemeX: Advancing Cultural Metaphoric Image Interpretation in Bangla with a Multimodal Explainable Dataset
items.title_zh: BanglaMemeX：推进孟加拉语文化隐喻图像理解的多模态可解释数据集
items.summary: BanglaMemeX is a benchmark of 3,000 Bangla memes annotated for humor, sarcasm, offensiveness, motivational intent and sentiment, with human-written explanations of textual and visual metaphors. The authors find that current VLMs struggle with implicit cultural cues despite reasonable surface-level accuracy.

items.title: Better Call CineCrew: Consistent Ultra-Long Narrative-to-Film Generation
items.title_zh: Better Call CineCrew：一致的超长叙事到电影生成
items.summary: CineCrew adds a structured multi-agent orchestration layer between screenplays and off-the-shelf video generators, centered on FilmDSL, a domain-specific language for shot, camera, asset and continuity constraints. A generation agent builds asset packs and storyboard keyframes while a critic agent produces structured QA signals for targeted refinement without retraining the base model.

items.title: Jakeschincariol/linkedin-agent-skill
items.title_zh: linkedin-agent-skill：11 个运营 LinkedIn 账号的 Claude 技能
items.summary: A Python repository bundling eleven free Claude skills for running a LinkedIn account, covering posts built on 21 hook formulas, replies, profile scoring, weekly plans and a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint.

items.title: undefined-ui/second-brain-os
items.title_zh: second-brain-os：可自我维护的 AI 第二大脑模板
items.summary: A starter kit for a self-maintaining AI second brain, bundling a guide, starter vault, agent skills and scripts for a self-organizing knowledge base in Claude Code and Obsidian.
